Enrollment Condition
data.description: Definition of enrolled participant
data.text: "Enrolled" means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day -7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee must review available safety data before titration to 30 mg/day
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Dose Escalation Safety Condition
data.description: Escalation to 30 mg/day occurs unless safety concerns exist
data.text: Dosing for ALXN1840 will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case, participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Adaptive extension of Outpatient Period requires Investigator approval and additional investigational product
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. In this situation, participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing throughout the Outpatient Period. In such cases, the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Continued Inpatient Stay Condition
data.description: Participants may remain in the CRU instead of being discharged on Day 9
data.text: Participants will be admitted to the CRU for Treatment Period 1 on Day -8 and may be discharged on Day 9 or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study. At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Adaptive Design Features
data.description: Adaptive features may be implemented at Investigator discretion without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Female Enrollment Pregnancy Test Condition
data.description: Negative serum pregnancy test required before enrollment of women of childbearing potential
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Hepatic Dose Modification Condition
data.description: Bilirubin elevation with ALT elevation indicative of liver injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hematologic Dose Modification Condition
data.description: Decline in neutrophils from baseline
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Condition
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening triggers dose decision
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data. Rationale for dosing decision must be documented in study record and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Condition
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening triggers dose decision
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease).

data.name: Rechallenge Condition
data.description: Limits and requirements for rechallenge after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. For rechallenges, participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: QTcF / ECG Clinically Significant Finding
data.description: Investigator determination of continuation after clinically significant finding
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Collection Period Duration Condition
data.description: Minimum and maximum lengths of intake/output collection periods
data.text: Overall, collection periods are a minimum of 3 days and as long as 15 days (which will be subdivided for analyses). Collection periods of at least 3 days were used to help minimize the impact of day-to-day variability on measurements.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up Condition
data.description: Definition and contact attempts before declaring lost to follow-up
data.text: A participant will be considered lost to follow-up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site. Before a participant is deemed lost to follow-up, the Investigator or designee must make every effort to regain contact with the participant (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter to the participant's last known mailing address or local equivalent methods).

data.name: US Screening-Only Site Condition
data.description: Sites in the US may perform screening procedures only
data.text: Addition of text applicable only to the US that details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures.

data.name: Screening to Run-in/Enrollment Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled on Day -7 and initiated on a copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet; participants are admitted to the CRU on Day -8 and assigned a participant number upon registration on Day -7.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run-in Period (Day -7 through Day -1, including baseline intake/output collection Day -4 through Day -1), participants will be administered ALXN1840 at 15 mg/day beginning on Day 1 for a treatment period of approximately 28 days.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the clinical research unit (CRU) on Day 9 to return on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose); participants may alternatively remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who are discharged will be re-admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 for Treatment Period 2 and will remain in house until Day 40; all procedures will start on Day 23. If the Outpatient Period is extended up to an additional 14 days, the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Escalation from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: Participants will be administered ALXN1840 at a dose of 15 mg/day on Day 1 through Day 28 and then increase to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, following SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Treatment Period 2 to End of Study Follow-up
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods of the study (ie, Day 40), participants will transition to prior or standard of care therapy and all participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/- 2 days).

data.name: Dose Reduction for Hematologic Abnormality
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hepatotoxicity
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN and with approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurologic or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes that it is in best interest of the participant.

data.name: Mandatory Consideration for Study Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur during the study: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it is necessary for the participant.

data.name: Continuation in Study After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow-up. See the SoA for data to be collected at the time of discontinuation of study intervention and follow-up.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (Day 40), participants will either transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or, at the discretion of the treating physician, consider and request continuation of ALXN1840 treatment permissible under local regulations for preapproval access.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal/Early Termination
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons. At the time of discontinuation, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (EOS/ET) should be conducted as shown in the SoA; the participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (ie, the EOS Visit on Day 54 +/- 2 days). The end of the study is defined as the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Should the participant continue to be unreachable after documented contact attempts (3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter), he/she will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor/Investigator
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason. Reasons for early closure may include failure of the Investigator to comply with the protocol, IRB/IEC or local health authority requirements, Alexion's procedures or GCP guidelines; inadequate recruitment of participants; or discontinuation of further study intervention development. A study site is considered closed when all participants have completed the end of study or early discontinuation visit.

data.name: Protocol Non-compliance / Disallowed Medication Exit
data.description: Use of disallowed medication (prescription medications within 14 days or 5 half-lives, or nonprescription drugs within 7 days or 5 half-lives, before Day -7 and until completion of the follow-up visit) or anticipated non-compliance/uncooperativeness requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: SRC Safety Review and Dose Titration Decision
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the SRC reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant; participants may remain on 15 mg/day if safety concerns exist.

data.name: CRU Discharge Decision at Day 9
data.description: Decision whether to discharge the participant from the CRU on Day 9 (returning Day 22 or 23) or keep them inpatient for safety or study integrity; the Outpatient Period may be extended up to 14 additional days with Investigator approval.

data.name: Dose Modification Decision Based on Safety Laboratory Results
data.description: Decision point for dose reduction, temporary interruption, restriction of dose increase, or rechallenge based on hepatic and hematologic laboratory criteria with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Assessment Dose Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor decide on dose interruption, increase, or decrease based on copper control parameters and clinical data; re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Eligibility/Enrollment Decision at Day -7
data.description: Participants who sign the ICF and are eligible are registered on Day -7 and assigned a participant number, with controlled diet initiated after registration/inclusion.

data.name: Post-Study Treatment Decision at Day 40
data.description: Decision at end of Inpatient Period 2 (Day 40) whether the participant resumes prior therapy, other standard of care therapy, or requests continued ALXN1840 via preapproval access.
